title: Replace Rust Free Functions With Methods
description: Replace Rust Free Functions With Methods
summary: Completed OO refactoring of compose/rs. Dissolved the flatten module into a region with top-level types. Converted all serialize_kit/deserialize_kit/are_kits_equal free function call sites (~40 across lib.rs and kit_backbone_async.rs) to Kit method calls (Kit::from_json_str, kit.to_json_pretty(), kit.are_equal()). Added missing top-level imports (RefCell, Rc, VecDeque). Build passes with only warnings, all 82 tests pass.
